title: Deion Sanders on Travis Hunter's usage: "I have no idea what's going on"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deion Sanders on Travis Hunter's usage: "I have no idea what's going on"
sources.description: Back in May, Colorado coach Deion Sanders expressed disappointment that he hadn't heard from the Jaguars regarding how to coach, and how to deploy, cornerback/receiver Travis Hunter.
